# This file was autogenerated by uv via:
#    uv pip compile --no-strip-extras --python-platform linux --constraint=requirements/common-constraints.txt --output-file=requirements.txt requirements/requirements.in
# then hand-patched to restore the python_version marker branches for
# numpy/scipy/tree-sitter/audioop-lts (see requirements/python-compat.in
# and requirements/pydub.in) that a single-platform, non-universal
# compile collapses to one pinned version -- breaking Python 3.10 CI,
# which needs numpy<2/scipy<1.16 while 3.11+ needs newer versions.
# A `--universal` recompile is blocked by a real pre-existing conflict
# between python-compat.in's scipy<1.16 (for <3.11) and
# common-constraints.txt's unconditional scipy==1.17.1 pin -- worth
# fixing properly in a follow-up, not patched here to keep this PR
# scoped to the MCP feature.
